name: Ludo
summary: Ludo is a turn-based race board game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to four players who join one table with a short room code, each on their own phone or computer. Each player races four pieces from a corner base around the board to the centre. A six is needed to leave base; a six, a capture or a piece reaching home earns another throw, but three sixes in a row lose the turn. Landing on a rival sends that piece back to base, except on the eight starred safe squares or against a pair of one colour. The centre must be reached by exact count, and the first player with all four pieces home wins. Turns are timed at 30 seconds. There are no computer opponents.
